skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the economic value and components of natural resources, the necessity of valuing natural resources, and the role of the valuer.
Explain, construct, and select valuation processes and methods for natural resources.
Apply valuation methods to specific natural resources and products/services.
Recognize and comply with legal regulations and ethical responsibilities in resource valuation.
Work effectively in teams to solve problems and present findings.
Analyze real-world valuation issues and propose solutions.
